# Bounder

> An open physical-interlock architecture and simulation testbed for checking narrow, signed authority and local conditions at a machine's point of action.

Bounder currently provides browser simulations, policy contracts, and recorded evidence. Device integration, hardware-in-the-loop testing, and platform-specific safety validation remain development goals.

## Architecture and laboratory

- [Overview](https://www.bounder.io/): Architecture, example applications, recorded Fleet exercises, and development roadmap.
- [Simulator](https://www.bounder.io/simulator.html): Browser verification laboratory and guided tour of protective boundaries.
